# 批图网 - Free Online Image Processing Toolkit
> Pure local processing, no server upload. Compress, convert, crop, resize, and apply filters to images directly in your browser.

## What is 批图网?
批图网 is a free online image processing toolkit. All processing happens locally in your browser — no images are ever uploaded to any server. Supports batch processing, format conversion (PNG, JPEG, WebP, AVIF, GIF, BMP, ICO, TIFF), compression (lossy/lossless/target size), cropping, resizing, filters, watermark (text/image), and borders.

## Key Features
- 100% local processing — privacy guaranteed
- Permanently free, no registration required
- Batch processing support
- 10+ image format support (PNG, JPEG, WebP, AVIF, GIF, BMP, ICO, TIFF, HEIC, SVG)
- Drag & drop, paste from clipboard, URL fetch, ZIP extraction
- Compression: quality slider, lossless, target file size
- Crop: free ratio, presets (1:1, 3:2, 4:3, 16:9, 9:16)
- Resize: percentage, pixel, fit-to-size with aspect ratio lock
- Filters: brightness, contrast, saturation, grayscale, sepia, blur, invert
- Watermark: text or image overlay with position control
- Border: customizable width, color, radius
- Metadata viewing and cleanup
- Dark mode support
- Responsive design (mobile-friendly)

## For LLM Crawlers
This site provides a complete online image processing service. All tools are freely accessible without login. The processing pipeline runs entirely client-side. For AI-powered search, key content includes:
- 10 FAQ items covering privacy, formats, batch processing, limits
- Detailed privacy policy confirming zero data collection
- Terms of service with free usage declaration
- Each tool page (compress, crop, resize, filter, convert) serves as standalone documentation on how the specific image operation works.
